senses.en: a person who regularly visits a particular place

example.en: The old cafe is full of habitues who come every morning.
example.zh: 这家老咖啡馆满是每天早晨都来的常客。

collocations: a habitue of the local bar

senses.en: in the company of; together with

example.en: She went shopping with her friend.
example.zh: 她和朋友去购物了。

senses.en: using a tool or instrument

example.en: He cut the paper with scissors.
example.zh: 他用剪刀剪纸。

senses.en: a person who goes to stores to buy things

example.en: The mall was full of shoppers before the holidays.
example.zh: 假期前购物中心挤满了购物者。

senses.en: not complete or not perfect; having faults

example.en: Humans are imperfect and everyone makes mistakes.
example.zh: 人都不完美，人人都会犯错。

senses.en: a verb tense expressing ongoing or repeated past action
senses.zh: （语法）未完成过去时；未完成体

example.en: The imperfect in Spanish often describes habitual past actions.
example.zh: 西班牙语的未完成过去时常用于描述过去的习惯性动作。

senses.en: in a worried or nervous way

example.en: She waited anxiously for the test results.
example.zh: 她焦急地等待考试成绩。

senses.en: a formal written agreement between two or more parties

example.en: The two companies signed a covenant to share the technology.
example.zh: 两家公司签署了共享技术的契约。

senses.en: in the Bible, an agreement between God and his people

example.en: The Old Testament describes God's covenant with Israel.
example.zh: 《旧约》描述了上帝与以色列人立的圣约。

senses.en: to promise by a formal agreement

example.en: The tenants covenanted to keep the garden in good condition.
example.zh: 租户立约保持花园的良好状态。

senses.en: in the exact sense of the words; not figuratively

example.en: She took his remark literally and felt hurt.
example.zh: 她按字面理解他的话，感到受伤。

senses.en: used informally for emphasis, often when the statement is not literally true
senses.zh: （口语）简直；确实（用于强调，常非字面）

example.en: When he heard the news, he was literally jumping for joy.
example.zh: 听到这个消息时，他简直高兴得跳了起来。

senses.en: money paid to a worker for work done, usually calculated by the hour, day, or week

example.en: The company pays a fair wage to its workers.
example.zh: 公司向员工支付公平的工资。

senses.en: to carry on a war, campaign, or struggle

example.en: The government waged a campaign to improve public health.
example.zh: 政府开展了一场改善公共卫生的运动。

senses.en: The release of gas, light, heat, or other energy into the environment.

example.en: New rules aim to cut emissions from power plants.
example.zh: 新规定旨在减少发电厂的排放。

senses.en: A substance or form of energy that is released into the environment.

example.en: The measured emissions included carbon dioxide and water vapor.
example.zh: 测得的排放物包括二氧化碳和水蒸气。

senses.en: a set of rules, ideas, or principles used to plan or understand something
senses.zh: 用于规划或理解某事物的规则、思想或原则体系

example.en: The new policy provides a framework for improving public services.
example.zh: 新政策为改善公共服务提供了一个框架。

senses.en: the basic structure that supports something or gives it shape
senses.zh: 支撑某物或使其成形的基本结构

example.en: Steel beams form the framework of the building.
example.zh: 钢梁构成了这座建筑的框架。

senses.en: a person who operates a machine or piece of equipment

example.en: The machine operator checked the settings before starting the line.
example.zh: 机器操作员在启动生产线前检查了设置。

senses.en: a symbol or function representing a mathematical operation
senses.zh: 表示数学运算的符号或函数

example.en: In this expression, the plus sign is an operator.
example.zh: 在这个表达式中，加号是一个运算符。

senses.en: a person who connects telephone calls

example.en: The telephone operator connected the call to the correct office.
example.zh: 电话接线员将电话转接到正确的办公室。

senses.en: a person or company that runs a business or service

example.en: The bus operator added a new route.
example.zh: 公交运营商新增了一条线路。

senses.en: the flat area between the waist and knees of a seated person

example.en: She held the sleeping baby in her lap.
example.zh: 她把熟睡的婴儿抱在腿上。

senses.en: one complete circuit of a track or course

example.en: He ran the final lap in under a minute.
example.zh: 他最后一圈跑了不到一分钟。

senses.en: to drink by taking liquid into the mouth with the tongue

example.en: The cat lapped milk from a bowl.
example.zh: 猫从碗里舔喝牛奶。

senses.en: to officially leave a job or position voluntarily

example.en: She resigned from her job last month.
example.zh: 她上个月辞去了工作。

senses.en: to give up a right, claim, or position formally
senses.zh: 正式放弃权利、主张或职位

example.en: He resigned his claim to the property.
example.zh: 他放弃了对该财产的权利主张。

senses.en: to accept something unpleasant because you cannot change it
senses.zh: 无奈接受无法改变的不快之事

example.en: They resigned themselves to the delay.
example.zh: 他们只好接受了这次延误。

senses.en: a curved device used for hanging or catching things

example.en: Hang your coat on the hook by the door.
example.zh: 把你的外套挂在门边的挂钩上。

senses.en: to catch or fasten something with a hook

example.en: She hooked the trailer to the truck.
example.zh: 她把拖车挂到了卡车上。

senses.en: a curved shape or a punch thrown in a curve (boxing)

example.en: The boxer knocked his opponent down with a left hook.
example.zh: 拳击手用一记左钩拳将对手击倒。

senses.en: the area in a hotel or office where visitors are greeted

example.en: Please check in at the reception when you arrive.
example.zh: 到达时请在前台办理入住。

senses.en: a formal social event to welcome or celebrate people

example.en: The wedding reception was held in a hotel ballroom.
example.zh: 婚礼招待会在一家酒店的宴会厅举行。

senses.en: the way something, such as a new idea, is received by people; also the quality of a radio or phone signal

example.en: The new policy got a warm reception from the public.
example.zh: 新政策受到了公众的热烈欢迎。

senses.en: things that people do, especially for enjoyment or as part of a group

example.en: The school offers many after-school activities.
example.zh: 学校提供许多课外活动。

senses.en: the state of being busy or active

example.en: The town is full of activity in summer.
example.zh: 夏天这个小镇充满活力。

senses.en: existing first or earliest; not a later copy or version

example.en: This is the original plan, before any changes were made.
example.zh: 这是最初的计划，在做出任何修改之前。

senses.en: new and different in a creative way

example.en: She came up with an original idea for the school project.
example.zh: 她为学校项目想出了一个新颖的主意。

senses.en: the first or main version of something, from which copies can be made

example.en: The museum keeps the original in a protected room.
example.zh: 博物馆将原件保存在一个受保护的房间里。

senses.en: to a very high degree

example.en: The instructions were extremely clear.
example.zh: 这些说明极其清楚。

senses.en: the ability or willingness to act independently and start things without being told

example.en: She showed initiative by solving the problem before being asked.
example.zh: 她主动解决了问题，展现了主动性。

senses.en: a new plan or action intended to solve a problem or achieve a goal

example.en: The city launched an initiative to reduce food waste.
example.zh: 该市发起了一项减少食物浪费的倡议。

senses.en: the power or opportunity to act first and control a situation

example.en: He took the initiative in the negotiations and proposed a compromise.
example.zh: 他在谈判中掌握了主动，提出了一项妥协方案。

senses.en: a person's own nature, character, or identity

example.en: After the holiday, she felt like her old self again.
example.zh: 假期过后，她感觉又恢复了以前的状态。

senses.en: a person's own interests or advantage, especially when considered selfishly

example.en: He always puts self first.
example.zh: 他总是把自己放在第一位。

senses.en: an edible nut with a shiny brown shell, or the tree that produces it

example.en: We roasted chestnuts over the fire in autumn.
example.zh: 秋天我们在火上烤栗子。

senses.en: a reddish-brown color

example.en: Her horse has a beautiful chestnut coat.
example.zh: 她的马有一身漂亮的栗色皮毛。

senses.en: reddish-brown in color

example.en: She dyed her hair chestnut last month.
example.zh: 她上个月把头发染成了栗色。

senses.en: very strong anger, especially in formal or literary language

example.en: The villagers feared the king's wrath after the failed harvest.
example.zh: 歉收之后，村民们害怕国王的震怒。

senses.en: to hang or project over something

example.en: Tree branches overhang the garden wall.
example.zh: 树枝悬垂在花园的围墙上方。

senses.en: something that projects or hangs over something else

example.en: The roof has a wide overhang that keeps rain off the walls.
example.zh: 屋顶有一个很宽的悬挑部分，可以挡住雨水淋到墙上。

senses.en: a looming threat or excess supply, especially in finance (e.g. of unsold inventory or debt)
senses.zh: 悬顶之压；过剩（如库存或债务过多）

example.en: The market still faces an overhang of unsold homes.
example.zh: 市场仍面临未售出房屋过剩的压力。

senses.en: a figure of speech that describes one thing as if it were another, without using 'like' or 'as'

example.en: Her voice is music to my ears.
example.zh: 她的声音在我听来如同音乐。

senses.en: a person who teaches and trains people or animals in a sport or skill

example.en: The fitness trainer designed a workout plan for her.
example.zh: 健身教练为她制定了一份锻炼计划。

senses.en: a shoe worn for sports or exercise (British English)

example.en: I bought a new pair of trainers for running.
example.zh: 我买了一双新的运动鞋用来跑步。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Jason is coming to the party tonight.
example.zh: 贾森今晚要来参加聚会。

senses.en: in Greek mythology, the leader of the Argonauts who sailed in quest of the Golden Fleece
senses.zh: （希腊神话）伊阿宋，寻找金羊毛的阿尔戈英雄首领

example.en: In Greek myth, Jason led the Argonauts to find the Golden Fleece.
example.zh: 在希腊神话中，伊阿宋率领阿尔戈英雄寻找金羊毛。

senses.en: a large group of families related by blood or marriage, especially in Scotland

example.en: Members of the clan gathered for the yearly feast.
example.zh: 宗族成员聚在一起参加一年一度的宴席。

senses.en: an informal group of people with a shared interest

example.en: A small clan of gamers meets at the shop every weekend.
example.zh: 一小群游戏玩家每周末在店里聚会。

senses.en: a piece of film or video that has been recorded

example.en: The news channel broadcast rare footage of the eclipse.
example.zh: 新闻频道播出了日食的珍贵影像。

senses.en: length or area measured in feet, often used for pricing or measurement

example.en: They charged for the carpet by the square footage.
example.zh: 地毯按平方英尺计价收费。

senses.en: a device or system for sending messages over long distances by wire, using coded signals

example.en: In the 19th century, news traveled quickly by telegraph.
example.zh: 在19世纪，消息通过电报快速传播。

senses.en: to send a message by telegraph

example.en: She telegraphed her family that she had arrived safely.
example.zh: 她打电报告知家人她已平安到达。

senses.en: to make something obvious in advance, often unintentionally

example.en: He telegraphed his next move, so his opponent was ready.
example.zh: 他提前暴露了下一步动作，所以对手早有准备。

senses.en: to make someone or something poor

example.en: Years of war impoverished the region.
example.zh: 多年的战争使这个地区变得贫困。

senses.en: to weaken or reduce the quality of something

example.en: Overfarming can impoverish the soil.
example.zh: 过度耕作会使土壤变得贫瘠。

senses.en: the father of your husband or wife

example.en: My father-in-law invited us over for dinner on Sunday.
example.zh: 我公公（岳父）邀请我们星期天过去吃晚饭。

senses.en: an animal that has a backbone, such as a fish, bird, or mammal

example.en: Fish, birds, and humans are all vertebrates.
example.zh: 鱼、鸟和人类都是脊椎动物。

senses.en: having a backbone

example.en: Vertebrate animals share many similar body structures.
example.zh: 脊椎动物有许多相似的身体结构。

senses.en: the hip, buttock and upper thigh of a person or animal

example.en: The lion crouched, muscles taut in its haunches.
example.zh: 狮子蹲伏着，后腿肌肉紧绷。

senses.en: to show a feeling or quality clearly

example.en: The witness evinced no fear in court.
example.zh: 证人在法庭上毫无惧色。

senses.en: laziness; lack of desire to work or make effort

example.en: He was dismissed for sloth and neglect of duty.
example.zh: 他因懒惰和玩忽职守而被解雇。

senses.en: a slow-moving tree-dwelling mammal of Central and South America

example.en: A sloth hung from a branch, moving almost imperceptibly.
example.zh: 一只树懒挂在树枝上，几乎一动不动。

senses.en: a small or medium-sized dog with long silky ears, often kept as a pet or hunting dog

example.en: The spaniel wagged its tail happily.
example.zh: 那只长毛垂耳狗高兴地摇着尾巴。

senses.en: to argue over small or unimportant details

example.en: Let's not quibble over minor details.
example.zh: 我们别在细枝末节上争辩了。

senses.en: a small objection or argument over minor details
senses.zh: 小异议；吹毛求疵的挑剔

example.en: That's just a quibble; the plan is basically good.
example.zh: 那只是吹毛求疵；这个计划基本上是好的。

senses.en: too large or plentiful to be used up completely

example.en: He seemed to have an inexhaustible supply of energy.
example.zh: 他似乎有用不完的精力。

senses.en: very distant in space or time

example.en: She stared at the faraway mountains for a long time.
example.zh: 她久久地凝望着远处的群山。

senses.en: showing that one's thoughts are elsewhere; dreamy

example.en: He answered my question with a faraway look in his eyes.
example.zh: 他目光恍惚地回答了我的问题。

collocations: a faraway look in one's eyes

senses.en: a feeling of intense happiness or excitement

example.en: There was a sense of euphoria after the team won the final.
example.zh: 球队赢得决赛后，人们沉浸在欢欣之中。

senses.en: a cloth used to wrap a body for burial

example.en: The body was wrapped in a white shroud.
example.zh: 遗体被裹在白色的裹尸布里。

senses.en: to cover or hide something completely

example.en: The mountain was shrouded in mist.
example.zh: 群山笼罩在雾中。

senses.en: instead of; in place of (used in the phrase 'in lieu of')
senses.zh: 替代（用于短语 in lieu of，意为“代替”）

example.en: He was given a day off in lieu of the overtime pay.
example.zh: 他获得一天休假以代替加班费。

senses.en: a sudden sharp feeling of pain or emotion

example.en: She felt a pang of guilt after lying.
example.zh: 撒谎后她感到一阵内疚。

senses.en: floating on water without control or anchor

example.en: The damaged boat was left adrift at sea.
example.zh: 受损的小船在海上漂流。

senses.en: lacking direction or purpose in life

example.en: After losing his job, he felt adrift.
example.zh: 失业后，他感到迷茫。

senses.en: straying from the correct path or accepted standards
senses.zh: 偏离正道的；误入歧途的

example.en: He was sent to bring back the errant sheep.
example.zh: 他被派去把走散的羊赶回来。

senses.en: wandering or moving irregularly; unpredictable
senses.zh: 游离不定的；四处漂泊的

example.en: An errant gust of wind scattered the papers.
example.zh: 一阵乱刮的风把文件吹散了。

senses.en: very harmful, often in a gradual or hidden way
senses.zh: 有害的；恶性的（常指潜移默化的危害）

example.en: The article challenged a pernicious myth about education.
example.zh: 这篇文章质疑了一种有关教育的有害谬论。

senses.en: a building or group of buildings where goods are made

example.en: The new factory will employ 200 workers.
example.zh: 这家新工厂将雇用200名工人。

senses.en: in computing, a routine or object that creates other objects
senses.zh: （计算机）工厂；创建对象的例程或对象

example.en: The program uses a factory to create database objects.
example.zh: 该程序使用工厂来创建数据库对象。

senses.en: a green vegetable with thick stalks and tightly packed flower heads

example.en: She steamed the broccoli until it was tender.
example.zh: 她把西兰花蒸到变软。

senses.en: a person who works with you

example.en: My coworker helped me finish the report.
example.zh: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。

senses.en: firm and brittle, breaking easily with a crunch

example.en: The fresh lettuce is nice and crisp.
example.zh: 新鲜的生菜又脆又好。

senses.en: fresh, clean, and slightly cold (air, weather); clear and sharp (images, sound)
senses.zh: 清爽的；清新的；清晰鲜明的

example.en: We enjoyed a walk in the crisp morning air.
example.zh: 我们在清新凉爽的晨间空气中散步。

senses.en: (British English) a thin slice of potato fried until crunchy, sold in bags; (American English: potato chip)

example.en: She shared a bag of salt and vinegar crisps.
example.zh: 她分了一袋盐醋味薯片。

senses.en: to make or become crisp by heating

example.en: Grill the bread until the edges crisp.
example.zh: 把面包烤到边缘变脆。

senses.en: a mountain or opening in the earth's surface from which molten rock, ash, and gases can erupt

example.en: The volcano erupted, sending ash high into the sky.
example.zh: 火山喷发了，把火山灰喷到高空中。

senses.en: a sharp curved nail on the toe of an animal, bird or reptile

example.en: The cat sharpened its claws on the scratching post.
example.zh: 猫在猫抓板上磨爪子。

senses.en: a curved mechanical device used to grab or hold things

example.en: The crane's claw picked up the scrap metal.
example.zh: 起重机的抓爪抓起了废金属。

senses.en: to scratch or tear at something with claws

example.en: The kitten clawed at the ball of yarn.
example.zh: 小猫用爪子抓毛线球。

senses.en: to fail to meet someone's hopes or expectations

example.en: The movie was great, but the ending disappointed me.
example.zh: 电影很精彩，但结局让我很失望。

senses.en: a piece of clothing worn on the foot inside a shoe

example.en: I put on a pair of warm socks before putting on my boots.
example.zh: 我穿上一双暖和的短袜，然后再穿靴子。

senses.en: to hit someone or something hard

example.en: He socked the punching bag as hard as he could.
example.zh: 他用尽全力猛击沙袋。

senses.en: the amount of something in a given space or per unit size

example.en: Water has a higher density than oil.
example.zh: 水的密度比油高。

senses.en: the degree to which things are crowded together in a place

example.en: The density of traffic makes the city noisy.
example.zh: 交通的密集程度使这座城市很嘈杂。

senses.en: fine-grained earth that can be shaped when wet and hardens when fired, used for pottery and bricks

example.en: The potter shaped the vase out of clay.
example.zh: 陶工用黏土塑造出花瓶。

senses.en: the movement of people or goods from one place to another

example.en: The city improved its public transit system last year.
example.zh: 该市去年改善了公共交通系统。

senses.en: the act of passing through or across a place

example.en: We had a four-hour transit in Singapore.
example.zh: 我们在新加坡中转了四个小时。

senses.en: to pass through or across a place

example.en: The train transits the tunnel in under five minutes.
example.zh: 火车在五分钟内穿过隧道。

senses.en: the way a story, film, or event finishes

example.en: The movie has a surprising ending.
example.zh: 这部电影的结局令人意外。

senses.en: the act of bringing something to an end; termination

example.en: The ending of the war brought relief to everyone.
example.zh: 战争的结束让所有人都松了一口气。

senses.en: a letter or group of letters added to the end of a word

example.en: The ending -ly often turns an adjective into an adverb.
example.zh: 词尾 -ly 常把形容词变成副词。

senses.en: very pleasing or attractive; delightful

example.en: She has a charming smile that makes everyone feel welcome.
example.zh: 她的笑容很迷人，让每个人都感到受欢迎。

senses.en: to cut a design into a surface using acid or a sharp tool

example.en: The artist etched a scene of mountains onto the metal plate.
example.zh: 艺术家在金属板上蚀刻了一幅山景。

senses.en: to fix something clearly in the mind or memory

example.en: That rainy afternoon is etched in my memory.
example.zh: 那个下雨的午后深深刻在我的记忆里。

senses.en: completely clean and free of germs

example.en: Surgical instruments must be sterile.
example.zh: 手术器械必须无菌。

senses.en: unable to produce offspring or crops

example.en: The soil in the region is too sterile for farming.
example.zh: 该地区的土壤过于贫瘠，不适合耕种。

senses.en: a feeling of worry or fear about something that may happen

example.en: She felt some apprehension before the interview.
example.zh: 面试前她感到有些忧虑。

senses.en: understanding or grasp of something

example.en: He has a quick apprehension of new ideas.
example.zh: 他对新思想领会很快。

senses.en: a light, fizzy type of beer stored for a long time before being sold

example.en: He ordered a cold lager at the bar.
example.zh: 他在吧台点了一杯冰镇拉格啤酒。

senses.en: simple and plain, in a homely country style
senses.zh: 朴实无华的；乡土气息的

example.en: She offered some homespun wisdom about hard work.
example.zh: 她讲了一些关于勤劳的朴实道理。

senses.en: rough cloth woven at home

example.en: He wore a jacket made of coarse homespun.
example.zh: 他穿着一件粗土布做的外套。

senses.en: a flammable plastic once widely used for photographic film and small articles

example.en: Early movies were shot on celluloid.
example.zh: 早期电影是用赛璐珞胶片拍摄的。

senses.en: the film industry or movies in general

example.en: She spent her whole career in celluloid.
example.zh: 她的整个职业生涯都在影坛度过。

senses.en: artificial or unreal, like something in a movie

example.en: His celluloid smile never seemed genuine.
example.zh: 他虚假的笑容从来不显得真诚。

senses.en: a small nocturnal mammal covered with protective spines that curls into a ball when threatened

example.en: A hedgehog curled into a ball in the garden.
example.zh: 花园里一只刺猬蜷成了球。

senses.en: either of the two times each year when day and night are of equal length
senses.zh: 昼夜平分点；春分或秋分

example.en: The spring equinox falls around March 20.
example.zh: 春分在3月20日左右。

senses.en: to make a figure or object by carving or shaping material such as stone or clay

example.en: The artist sculpted a horse from a block of marble.
example.zh: 这位艺术家用一块大理石雕刻出一匹马。

senses.en: to shape something carefully, such as muscles or a landscape

example.en: Swimming helps sculpt your shoulders and arms.
example.zh: 游泳有助于塑造肩膀和手臂的线条。

senses.en: the final and highest point reached after a process

example.en: Winning the award was the culmination of years of effort.
example.zh: 获奖是多年努力的顶点。

collocations: the culmination of years of work

senses.en: money paid by the government to people who are unemployed (British English)

example.en: He was out of work and living on the dole.
example.zh: 他失业了，靠失业救济金生活。

senses.en: to give out shares of food, money or other things

example.en: Volunteers doled out soup to the people waiting in line.
example.zh: 志愿者向排队的人分发汤。

senses.en: the shape and structure of a person's body

example.en: Years of training gave him a strong physique.
example.zh: 多年的训练使他拥有强壮的体格。

senses.en: a calm and peaceful state, free from disturbance

example.en: She enjoyed the tranquility of the quiet mountain lake.
example.zh: 她享受着宁静山湖的平静。

senses.en: a very hard gray stone used to make sparks and tools

example.en: Early humans made tools from flint.
example.zh: 早期人类用燧石制作工具。

senses.en: hard and showing no emotion; unfeeling

example.en: She gave him a flint stare.
example.zh: 她冷硬地盯着他。

senses.en: to make someone lose admiration or enthusiasm for something

example.en: The scandal disenchanted many of the singer's fans.
example.zh: 这一丑闻使这位歌手的许多粉丝不再着迷。

senses.en: a lock that snaps shut automatically by the action of a spring

example.en: The old cabinet was secured with a springlock.
example.zh: 那个旧柜子用弹簧锁锁着。
